spans.s:
भेरि mf. (-रिः-री) A kettle-drum.
 E. भी to fear, to cause to fear, Unādi
aff. क्रिन्; otherwise रन् aff., and ङीप् added; also भेर.

भेरुण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Formidable, fearful.
 f. (-ण्डा) One of the Yak-
shinis, or female attendants on DURGĀ.
 m. (-ण्डः) A particular
deity; a form of ŚIVA, according to the Tantras.
 n. (-ण्डं) Con-
ception, impregnation.
 E. भी to fear, deriv. irr.; it is sometimes
read भरण्ड ।
